summary: Validated Expo web preview at desktop and mobile widths, onboarding, responsive navigation, capture validation/form, journal search/filter surface, mood/me routes, and backend CRUD regression.

minor.issue: Test expects EXPO_BACKEND_URL, while frontend/.env provides EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL; running pytest without mapping the configured variable fails before making a request.

action_items: Align backend regression test configuration with the protected frontend env key, or document the required EXPO_BACKEND_URL mapping.
critical_code_review_comments: Frontend API URL correctly uses environment configuration; no hardcoded preview URL found.
Backend responses exclude MongoDB _id and CRUD regression passed.
seed_data_creation: No persistent seed data created; test data was cleaned by the existing regression test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview loaded at desktop 1920x1080 and mobile 375x667. Onboarding completed, all five web tabs navigated, capture validation displayed, journal search and mood selection rendered, and mobile document width did not overflow.
rca_of_issue: The unconfigured backend test run reads os.environ.get('EXPO_BACKEND_URL') and constructs None/api/...; the app env uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Mapping EXPO_BACKEND_URL to the configured public value makes the existing CRUD test pass.
